NeuralNg Breadcrumb rules

- Import `NeuralBreadcrumb`, `NeuralBreadcrumbItemComponent`, and `NeuralBreadcrumbSeparatorTemplate` only from `@neural-ng/core/breadcrumb`.
- Add only the canonical runtime symbols used by the template directly to standalone component imports.
- Never generate deprecated `BreadcrumbComponent`, `BreadcrumbItemComponent`, or `BreadcrumbSeparatorTemplate` aliases in new code.
- Every item needs a stable `key` and visible `label`.
- Prefer `routerLink` for Angular routes and `href` for document navigation.
- The last item is current by default; use `current` only to override it.
- `maxItems >= 2` collapses middle items into an accessible NeuralNg Menu.
- `overflowLabel` labels the trigger and provides its hover/focus Tooltip.
- `overflowTooltipDelay` defaults to `100` milliseconds.
- Use either `[items]` or `<neural-breadcrumb-item>` children, never both.
- Customize separators with `separatorIconClass` or
  `<ng-template neuralBreadcrumbSeparator>`.
- `itemSelect` emits `{ key, item, originalEvent }`.
- `unstyled` removes visual classes, not semantics or structural hooks.
- `routerLink` accepts a string, command array, or UrlTree and composes with `queryParams`, `fragment`, `queryParamsHandling`, `preserveFragment`, `skipLocationChange`, `replaceUrl`, `state`, and `target`.
- `href` retains native `target` and `rel` behavior.
- Do not add custom arrow-key handlers; visible items retain native link behavior and overflow delegates to Neural Menu.
- Current maturity is Beta. Do not invent route construction, history, authorization, page-title, or tooltip APIs.
